title: Banning projects identified in the high-severity Watchdog Program cases - Good Entry
bodyExcerpt: Should Good Entry (including all founders, current team members, and affiliated contributors), be permanently banned from all future ArbitrumDAO programs? This proposal will not require an on-chain vote because there are no on-chain actions to be taken. Accordingly, this Snapshot vote aims to get social consensus from the DAO.
choices: AGAINST - Do not ban Good Entry
